core_stats.name: Agility
core_stats.description: Turn order and evasion (+2 evade per AGI)

core_stats.name: Intellect
core_stats.description: Adds 1% to spell damage and healing per effective point

core_stats.name: Vitality
core_stats.description: Base Vitality affects HP gains and status resistance; equipment bonuses are inactive

xp_curve.formula: floor(40 * level^0.7) + 30 — flattened per #121, ~4× growth L1→L15 (FF1-style); shared campaign rewards replace XP from removed filler battles

evade.description: Evasion value, subtracted from attacker hit chance

magic_defense.description: Inactive: enemies currently use physical attacks

attacks_per_turn.description: Number of hits per physical attack

level_up.stat_gain_method: Each stat rolls against class growth chance (X/8). Roll d8; if roll <= growth, stat gains +1.

hp_gain.description: Base HP from class + probabilistic VIT bonus. Strong levels get the bonus guaranteed.
